hero.title: I'm Jose Miguel González
hero.subtitle: Full Stack Developer specialized in React, Node.js and cloud solutions. AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate. +{years} years building scalable, high-performance applications.
experience.title: Professional Experience
exp_hl_agrimanager_1: Built 2 new modules end to end: requirements analysis, technical design, implementation, REST API integration, testing and deployment.
exp_hl_agrimanager_2: Built a WebView from scratch that connects the web features with the company's mobile app.
exp_hl_agrimanager_3: Maintain and evolve the entire production frontend application: root-cause analysis of bugs, performance and usability improvements.
exp_hl_astrolle_1: Migrating a monolithic frontend application to Micro Frontends: splitting it into independent modules and adapting them to Vite Module Federation to expose them as remotes.
exp_hl_astrolle_2: Integrating those remote modules into the host application of Astrolle's business platform, ensuring communication, compatibility and a consistent user experience.
exp_hl_astrolle_3: Built several important modules of the system.
exp_hl_astrolle_4: Design reusable components and define API contracts with the backend team; optimize performance and contribute to the evolution of the frontend architecture.
exp_hl_alcaldia_1: Designed and built a Java desktop application (NetBeans) with MySQL to manage the municipality's asset inventory.
exp_hl_alcaldia_2: Built and maintained the municipality's public web portal with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
exp_hl_alcaldia_3: Maintained hardware, networks and software of the local IT infrastructure, providing technical support to users.
exp_hl_alcaldia_4: Automated processes and built internal tools to support operations.
exp_hl_abc_1: Designed and built an inventory system with the MERN stack (React, Express, Node.js and MongoDB) for the store's administration: authentication and product management.
exp_hl_abc_2: Diagnosed and repaired smartphones, computers and other electronic devices.
exp_hl_abc_3: Technical support and maintenance of hardware and software for the business's daily operation.

projects.title: Projects
proj_fe_1_desc: Full-stack inventory management system: React and Zustand client, Express REST API with MongoDB and Swagger docs.
proj_fe_2_desc: Pizza menu and ordering app built with React, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Query and Supabase.
proj_fe_3_desc: Mobile device repair and management app built with React, TypeScript and Tailwind.
proj_fe_4_desc: Team project (3 people) to learn by building: generates project ideas tailored to your stack and level, with step-by-step guides, tasks, hints and solutions. React, TypeScript, Zustand and TanStack Query frontend; Express API with Prisma, Zod and PostgreSQL.
proj_fe_5_desc: Baby product guides and comparisons, built 100% with Astro and Preact islands only where content is dynamic (side-by-side comparison, filters). Full reviews and buying guides for strollers, car seats, cribs, baby monitors and high chairs.
proj_fe_6_desc: Multi-tenant SaaS for phone, computer and console repair shops: work orders, QR tracking, technicians, inventory and invoicing. Java + Spring Boot API with hexagonal architecture (ports and adapters) and PostgreSQL, recurring subscription billing via Wompi, React frontend and an Astro landing animated with GSAP.
proj_fe_7_desc: Restaurant menu and card generator in PDF built with Next.js: choose a template, add dishes, optional QR and download a print-ready PDF.
proj_be_1_desc: E-commerce REST API with NestJS, TypeORM and PostgreSQL: JWT authentication, image uploads to Cloudinary and OpenAPI/Swagger docs.
proj_be_2_desc: Online appointment system for veterinary clinics: pet owners book visits for their pets. React frontend with Redux Toolkit and Tailwind; Express REST API with TypeScript, TypeORM and PostgreSQL, and JWT authentication.
proj_be_3_desc: REST backend with Java, Spring Boot and JWT authentication for the mobile repair system.
proj_be_4_desc: Deliverables system for BP Ventures consultancy: file management with hierarchies, invoicing and payments, companies module and notifications. API documented in OpenAPI/Swagger with CI (GitHub Actions) syncing it to SwaggerHub.
proj_dev_1_desc: Infrastructure as Code practice with Terraform — exercises from basic to advanced (Terratest), simulating AWS locally with Floci/LocalStack.
proj_dev_2_desc: Interactive platform to practice AWS architecture challenges: drag services onto a canvas (React Flow), connect them and a declarative evaluation returns a score and feedback. CloudFormation/Terraform parsing, Zustand state, Zod validation and Vitest tests.
proj_dev_3_desc: Multi-tenant serverless attendance and presence system (schools and workplaces): QR check-in, GPS validation in Lambda, DynamoDB single-table, SNS notifications and a dashboard on S3 + CloudFront. Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and CI/CD with GitHub Actions + OIDC.
about.title: About me
about.bio1: Results-oriented Full Stack Developer specialized in JavaScript, React and Node.js. +{years} years building scalable, high-performance web applications.
about.bio2: Experience with REST APIs, modular architectures, databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL), Redux/Zustand, and AWS Solutions Architect certification.
about.bio3: Higher Technical Degree (TSU) in Computer Science (UPTNM), equivalent to a Tecnólogo in Colombia, complemented by the Soy Henry Full Stack bootcamp, courses and certifications. Passionate about creating impactful solutions and teamwork.
